The routine queries the context value for two operands, checks both with attribute_context_value_is_supported, then compares corresponding results in loops and returns a boolean. Callers use it while evaluating home/away attribute context. Evidence: decompiled/main/main_0081.c:44582-44600,44609-44629,44630-44660; decompiled/main/main_0081.c:40012-40016.

For a non-null pointer, iterates attribute selector IDs 0 through 4, fetches/validates the corresponding attribute record, and increments a count when each returned value has no bits set in mask 0xff; null returns zero. Pitcher-role selection calls it with an attribute record pointer. Evidence: decompiled/main/main_0108.c:36494-36516,36517-36538,36539-36555; decompiled/main/main_0108.c:30223-30227.

Builds 30 temporary rows pairing each candidate index with a selector-specific score, sorts them via qsort, then copies 30 pairs of 32-bit values to the output record. Its helper aggregate_attribute_candidate_scores_by_selector and callers pass selector indices in an attribute scoring path. Evidence: decompiled/main/main_0056.c:42663-42690,42692-42698,42699-42743; decompiled/main/main_0056.c:34774-34778.

Checks a gate and optional record path; obtains a context lookup result from the input record’s attribute ID and global context table, then returns a status/derived value from the selected record. Caller aggregate_related_attribute_values invokes it for indexed entries. Evidence: decompiled/main/main_0105.c:14256-14271,14274-14280,14282-14313; decompiled/main/main_0105.c:11648-11652.

Checks record/context status, obtains a status value and a 16-bit record field, then follows a context lookup path and returns either -2 or a small status code (up to 5). Multiple callers store its result in status fields. Evidence: decompiled/main/main_0116.c:6146-6168,6169-6184,6185-6191; decompiled/main/main_0116.c:6497-6501.

Uses an attribute selector to fetch a record value, passes the record and selector to compute_attribute_rating_value, then conditionally applies an additional selector-indexed bound and clamps the converted result to the observed range 0..0xb000. Caller compute_attribute_rating_from_record consumes the result as a float. Evidence: decompiled/main/main_0054.c:35902-35918,35919-35933,35935-35951; decompiled/main/main_0054.c:34817-34821.
